title: Package runs an install script
fix: Read the preinstall/install/postinstall script, then allow-list it or install with --ignore-scripts

title: Registry tarball has no integrity hash
fix: Delete the entry and run npm install so npm records a sha512 integrity

title: Integrity is sha1 only
fix: Regenerate the lockfile with npm 7+ so the entry carries sha512

title: Tarball fetched over plain http
fix: Point the registry at https:// and regenerate the entry

title: Dependency comes from a git URL
fix: Publish it to a registry or pin a full 40-character commit and review it

title: Tarball from a host that is not the npm registry
fix: Record who controls the host, or move the package to your registry

title: lockfileVersion 1 hides install scripts
fix: Upgrade to lockfileVersion 3 with npm 9+ so hasInstallScript is recorded

title: Direct dependency uses a floating range
fix: Replace *, latest, x or an empty range with a real semver range
